generationInputs.prompt: A vector illustration logo design with clean, sharp lines and flat color fills depicts an abstract representation of natural health. Attached to this stem are four stylized leaves of different solid colors. A bright yellow vector leaf is positioned on the left, angled slightly upward and to the right. Next to it is a bright blue vector leaf, slightly larger and oriented diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, overlapping the yellow leaf at its base. Above and slightly to the right of the blue leaf is a green vector leaf, pointing upwards and angled slightly to the right, with a visible stem connecting it to the main green stem. To the right and slightly below the blue leaf is a deep red vector leaf, pointing to the right and angled slightly upwards, partially overlapping the blue leaf. The light green stem does not extend beyond the leaves. The background is a plain white vector field.
